title: START
text: Head out on US-1 and Gordon Boulevard, then take I-95 North

title: Springfield, VA
text: Keep right onto I-495 North (Capital Beltway) toward Tysons Corner

title: Bethesda, MD
text: Keep left onto the I-270 Spur toward Rockville and Frederick

title: Frederick, MD
text: Take the exit for I-70 West toward Hagerstown

title: Breezewood, PA
text: Follow I-70 West through Breezewood onto the Pennsylvania Turnpike toward Pittsburgh

title: Lordstown, OH
text: Keep right to stay on the Ohio Turnpike, now I-80 West

title: Hammond, IN
text: Continue on I-90 West onto the Chicago Skyway

title: Chicago, IL
text: Keep left onto the Dan Ryan Expressway, I-90 and I-94 West

title: Portage, WI
text: Keep left on I-90 and I-94 West as I-39 splits off

title: Tomah, WI
text: Keep right onto I-94 West toward Eau Claire

title: Woodbury, MN
text: Take the exit for I-694 North around Saint Paul

title: Brooklyn Center, MN
text: Continue onto I-94 West toward Saint Cloud

title: DESTINATION
text: Take the I-90 Business exit, then turn left on First Avenue North into Billings
